name: Besor
line: Besor is a brook, or valley, in the far south of Judah where David left behind 200 tired men while he chased the Amalekite raiders.

moments.title: Two hundred stay behind
moments.text: David and his six hundred men came to the Brook of Besor. Two hundred men were too exhausted to cross, so they stayed there while David and four hundred men kept chasing the raiders.

moments.title: David shares the plunder
moments.text: When David came back to the men at the brook, some wicked men wanted to keep the plunder from them. David said the LORD had given the victory, and that those who stayed with the supplies would share alike with those who fought.
